title: Deep-merge two config objects
prompt: Create `merge.js` exporting `deepMerge(base, override)` (CommonJS). It returns a NEW object that deep-merges `override` into `base`: plain objects are merged recursively, every other value (arrays, primitives, null) from `override` replaces the one in `base`. Neither input is mutated. Keys only in `base` are kept; keys only in `override` are added. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
